scores.scale: 0 unusable, 5 functional with substantial friction, 7 good with clear rough edges, 10 exceptional in assessed scope. Scores reflect observed interaction quality, not winning, losing or unvisited content.

reasons.overall_mobile: Functional touch shooter with useful planning and recovery feedback, undermined in these attempts by sustained navigation and aiming friction.
reasons.controls: Two contacts moved and fired together; reload and use responded. Fine aiming, turning and choosing escape actions under fire were difficult; frequent movement overshoots and obstruction. No physical thumb ergonomics tested.
reasons.gameplay: Guard cue, recoveries, shield regeneration and armor windows gave understandable tactical goals. Recovering all three memories felt achievable, but route stalls and poor shot alignment dominated combat. Upload and victory unassessed.
reasons.presentation: Strong rain-soaked industrial atmosphere, coherent cyan/amber language, readable weapon and copper coils. Repetitive close wall surfaces made spatial understanding harder. Audio unassessed.
reasons.usability: Map pause, local zoom, nearest target and explicit fresh-start choice help. Route hints did not resolve repeated cover obstruction; handbook content visibly clipped below its scroll area on first view. No settings were changed.
reasons.readability: Large health/ammo and objective labels readable at 844x390. Small map labels, phase statistics and dense handbook text need more attention; banners compete with scene information. UI can update between sampled metadata and screenshot.
